title: The Story of an Hour
focus: a woman's brief taste of freedom

teacherSummary.text: Told gently that her husband Brently has died in a railroad accident, Louise Mallard weeps, then alone in her room feels a growing, monstrous joy: 'Free, free, free!' She looks ahead to years that will belong to herself. Leaving the room, she sees Brently walk in the door, unharmed; he had not been on the train. She dies, and the doctors say of 'the joy that kills'.
